stories.headline: Coding Agents Tripled Pull Requests. The Time Saved Never Showed Up.

pull_quote.text: Those gains haven't shown up as time saved, though. As far as we can observe, teams are working more, not less, suggesting AI has a Jevons paradox quality beyond token consumption.

stories.headline: Anthropic Is Watermarking Claude's Output Everywhere, Because Brussels Said So
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic is watermarking Claude's text worldwide to satisfy an EU rule it cannot geofence, adopting a scheme that peer-reviewed attacks show can be scrubbed by off-the-shelf paraphrasers more than 90 percent of the time.

pull_quote.text: For naive adversaries only using off-the-shelf paraphrasers, SynthID-Text is easier to scrub compared to other SOTA schemes. This can further be boosted to nearly 100% by using black-box queries to first steal the watermark before scrubbing it.
